recognize_zh: 淋巴結 kappa 免疫染色：整片有明顯的背景染色（血清免疫球蛋白），濾泡及其周圍的大細胞未見明確 kappa 強陽性；只有右側濾泡間區一條帶狀的強陽性漿細胞，與 lambda 染色對照可看出濾泡相關漿母細胞為 lambda 偏向。
features: Diffuse moderate background staining of interstitium and follicular dendritic meshwork, limiting interpretation
Concentric follicles (left and center) without distinct strongly kappa-positive large cells
A band of strongly kappa-positive plasma cells in an interfollicular zone on the right
Scattered isolated kappa-positive plasma cells elsewhere
Strongly stained vessel walls/serum within vascular channels
describe_en: Lymph node section immunostained for kappa light chain shows considerable diffuse background staining, including the follicular dendritic cell meshwork of concentrically arranged follicles. No distinct strongly kappa-positive large cells are identified in and around the follicles, where lambda-positive plasmablasts were seen, whereas a band of kappa-positive mature plasma cells is present in one interfollicular area and scattered positive cells occur elsewhere. The title's statement that plasma cells are kappa-negative is therefore only partly reflected, as a subset of interfollicular plasma cells is kappa-positive and the background limits interpretation. Taken with the lambda stain, findings support lambda-predominant follicle-associated plasmablasts, consistent with HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease; kappa/lambda ISH would give cleaner assessment.

ddx.vs: Reactive nodes show roughly twice as many kappa-positive as lambda-positive plasma cells in all compartments, not a lambda-skewed follicle-associated population.
A kappa-restricted process would show sheets of strongly kappa-positive cells with near-absent lambda, the opposite of this case.
Serum immunoglobulin causes diffuse extracellular and FDC staining, so only strong, crisp cytoplasmic staining should be counted, ideally confirmed by ISH.
